name: 40 - DB - Add Prescription Insurance Support Cases

parameters.query:
DO $$
DECLARE
    constraint_record RECORD;
BEGIN
    FOR constraint_record IN
        SELECT constraint_name
        FROM information_schema.table_constraints
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'human_handoff_tasks'
          AND constraint_type = 'CHECK'
    LOOP
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM pg_constraint constraint_item
            INNER JOIN pg_class relation
                ON relation.oid = constraint_item.conrelid
            WHERE relation.relname = 'human_handoff_tasks'
              AND constraint_item.conname =
                  constraint_record.constraint_name
              AND (
                    pg_get_constraintdef(
                        constraint_item.oid
                    ) ILIKE '%source_type%'

                    OR pg_get_constraintdef(
                        constraint_item.oid
                    ) ILIKE '%task_type%'
                  )
        ) THEN
            EXECUTE FORMAT(
                'ALTER TABLE human_handoff_tasks DROP CONSTRAINT %I',
                constraint_record.constraint_name
            );
        END IF;
    END LOOP;
END
$$;

ALTER TABLE human_handoff_tasks
    ADD CONSTRAINT human_handoff_tasks_source_type_check
    CHECK (
        source_type IN (
            'appointment_confirmation',
            'disruption_case',
            'waitlist_offer',
            'appointment',
            'medication_case',
            'insurance_case',
            'feedback_case',
            'manual'
        )
    );

ALTER TABLE human_handoff_tasks
    ADD CONSTRAINT human_handoff_tasks_task_type_check
    CHECK (
        task_type IN (
            'confirmation_no_response',
            'reschedule_request',
            'calendar_sync_issue',
            'medical_review',
            'complaint',
            'insurance_support',
            'manual_followup'
        )
    );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS prescription_insurance_support_cases (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    patient_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES patients(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    appointment_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES appointments(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    request_type TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            request_type IN (
                'prescription_registration_status',
                'insurance_submission_status',
                'tracking_code_lookup',
                'prescription_code_not_received',
                'insurance_rejection',
                'prescription_correction_request',
                'coverage_question',
                'pharmacy_dispensing_issue',
                'duplicate_or_invalid_prescription',
                'other_administrative_issue'
            )
        ),

    insurance_provider TEXT,
    prescription_identifier TEXT,
    prescription_date DATE,
    medication_name TEXT,

    patient_message TEXT NOT NULL,

    is_time_sensitive BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    source_channel TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'whatsapp'
        CHECK (
            source_channel IN (
                'whatsapp',
                'sms',
                'phone',
                'telegram',
                'web',
                'manual'
            )
        ),

    consent_to_contact BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    priority TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal'
        CHECK (
            priority IN (
                'low',
                'normal',
                'high',
                'urgent'
            )
        ),

    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new'
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'new',
                'in_review',
                'awaiting_patient',
                'awaiting_external',
                'resolved',
                'closed'
            )
        ),

    registration_status TEXT,
    insurance_submission_status TEXT,
    found_tracking_code TEXT,
    rejection_reason TEXT,

    handoff_task_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES human_handoff_tasks(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    assigned_to TEXT,
    response_to_patient TEXT,
    resolution_note TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_insurance_cases_active
    ON prescription_insurance_support_cases(
        status,
        priority,
        created_at
    )
    WHERE status IN (
        'new',
        'in_review',
        'awaiting_patient',
        'awaiting_external'
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_insurance_cases_patient
    ON prescription_insurance_support_cases(
        patient_id,
        created_at DESC
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_insurance_cases_appointment
    ON prescription_insurance_support_cases(
        appointment_id,
        created_at DESC
    )
    WHERE appointment_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_insurance_cases_prescription
    ON prescription_insurance_support_cases(
        prescription_identifier
    )
    WHERE prescription_identifier IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'migration_completed' AS result,
    'ساختار پشتیبانی نسخه، بیمه و کد رهگیری ایجاد شد.' AS message;

parameters.content:
## فقط یک‌بار اجرا شود

این Workflow جدول `prescription_insurance_support_cases` را ایجاد می‌کند.

همچنین `insurance_support` و `insurance_case` را به صف ارجاع انسانی اضافه می‌کند.

ساختار برای وضعیت ثبت نسخه، ارسال بیمه، کد رهگیری، رد بیمه، اصلاح نسخه و مشکلات داروخانه است.
